class ContrastiveAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name=MODEL_NAME, num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.output_hidden_states = True

        self.encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.encoder.gradient_checkpointing_enable()

        self.projection_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, PROJECTION_DIM),
        )

        self.classification_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, num_labels),
        )

        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.projection_head, self.classification_head]:
            for layer in module:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                elif isinstance(layer, nn.LayerNorm):
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classification_head(pooled_output)

        if return_embeddings:
            projections = self.projection_head(pooled_output)
            projections = F.normalize(projections, p=2, dim=1)
            return logits, projections
        return logits

    def encode_sentence(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.encoder(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                return_dict=True,
            )
            pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        return pooled_output

class NTXentLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.cross_entropy = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction="mean")

    def forward(self, anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings):
        batch_size = anchor_embeddings.size(0)
        anchor = F.normalize(anchor_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        positive = F.normalize(positive_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        negative = F.normalize(negative_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)

        pos_sim = torch.sum(anchor * positive, dim=1) / self.temperature
        neg_sim = torch.sum(anchor * negative, dim=1) / self.temperature

        logits = torch.stack([pos_sim, neg_sim], dim=1)
        labels = torch.zeros(batch_size, dtype=torch.long, device=anchor.device)
        loss = self.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
        return loss

class CombinedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, contrastive_weight=0.5, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.contrastive_weight = contrastive_weight
        self.contrastive_loss = NTXentLoss(temperature=temperature)
        self.classification_loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    def forward(
        self,
        logits,
        labels,
        anchor_embeddings,
        positive_embeddings,
        negative_embeddings,
    ):
        cls_loss = self.classification_loss(logits, labels)
        cont_loss = self.contrastive_loss(
            anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings
        )
        total_loss = cls_loss + self.contrastive_weight * cont_loss
        return total_loss, cls_loss, cont_loss

criterion = CombinedLoss(
    contrastive_weight=CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE
)
print(
    f"Criterion: CombinedLoss(contrastive_weight={CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT}, temperature={CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE})"
)

# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("CREATING DATALOADERS")
print("=" * 60)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)

def tokenize_texts(texts):

        list(texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

val_enc = tokenize_texts(X_val_texts)
test_enc = tokenize_texts(test_df["text"].values)

train_dataset = TensorDataset(
    train_enc["input_ids"],
    train_enc["attention_mask"],

)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,

test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,

# Contrastive dataset
class ContrastiveDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, anchor_texts, pos_texts, neg_texts, tokenizer, max_length=512):
        self.anchor_texts = anchor_texts
        self.pos_texts = pos_texts
        self.neg_texts = neg_texts
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.anchor_texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.anchor_texts[idx], self.pos_texts[idx], self.neg_texts[idx]

def collate_contrastive(batch):
    anchors = [item[0] for item in batch]
    positives = [item[1] for item in batch]
    negatives = [item[2] for item in batch]
    anchor_enc = tokenizer(
        anchors,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    pos_enc = tokenizer(
        positives,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    neg_enc = tokenizer(
        negatives,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    return (
        anchor_enc["input_ids"],
        anchor_enc["attention_mask"],
        pos_enc["input_ids"],
        pos_enc["attention_mask"],
        neg_enc["input_ids"],
        neg_enc["attention_mask"],
    )

max_contrastive_samples = 30000
# Ensure we use the minimum length across all arrays for subsampling
min_len = min(len(anchor_texts), len(pos_texts), len(neg_texts))
if min_len > max_contrastive_samples:
    idx = np.random.choice(min_len, max_contrastive_samples, replace=False)
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[:min_len][idx]
    pos_texts_sub = pos_texts[:min_len][idx]
    neg_texts_sub = neg_texts[:min_len][idx]
else:
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[:min_len]
    pos_texts_sub = pos_texts[:min_len]
    neg_texts_sub = neg_texts[:min_len]

contrastive_dataset = ContrastiveDataset(
    anchor_texts_sub, pos_texts_sub, neg_texts_sub, tokenizer
)
contrastive_loader = DataLoader(
    contrastive_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    collate_fn=collate_contrastive,
    drop_last=True,
)
print(f"Contrastive dataloader: {len(contrastive_loader)} batches")

# 12. OPTIMIZER & SCHEDULER

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("SETTING UP OPTIMIZER")
print("=" * 60)

no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight", "layer_norm.weight"]
encoder_params = []
head_params = []

for name, param in model.named_parameters():
    if not param.requires_grad:
        continue
    if "encoder" in name:
        if any(nd in name for nd in no_decay):
            encoder_params.append(
                {"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.0, "lr": LEARNING_RATE * 0.5}
            )
        else:
            encoder_params.append(
                {
                    "params": param,
                    "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
                    "lr": LEARNING_RATE * 0.5,

            )
    else:
        if any(nd in name for nd in no_decay):
            head_params.append(
                {"params": param, "weight_decay": 0.0, "lr": LEARNING_RATE * 2}
            )
        else:
            head_params.append(
                {"params": param, "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY, "lr": LEARNING_RATE * 2}
            )

optimizer = AdamW(encoder_params + head_params, lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)

total_steps = len(train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS * 2
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer,
    num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),
    num_training_steps=total_steps,
)

scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

# ============================================================
# 13. LOG LOSS FUNCTION
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

# ============================================================
# 14. TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("TRAINING")
print("=" * 60)

best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_epoch = 0
patience_counter = 0
contrastive_epochs = 2

for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    total_cls_loss = 0.0
    total_cont_loss = 0.0

    # Contrastive phase
    if epoch < contrastive_epochs or epoch % 2 == 0:
        for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(contrastive_loader):
            anc_ids, anc_mask, pos_ids, pos_mask, neg_ids, neg_mask = [
                b.to(device) for b in batch

            optimizer.zero_grad()

            with autocast():
                logits_anc, anchor_proj = model(
                    anc_ids, anc_mask, return_embeddings=True
                )
                logits_pos, pos_proj = model(pos_ids, pos_mask, return_embeddings=True)
                logits_neg, neg_proj = model(neg_ids, neg_mask, return_embeddings=True)

                dummy_labels = torch.zeros(
                    anc_ids.size(0), dtype=torch.long, device=device
                )
                total, cls_l, cont_l = criterion(
                    logits_anc,
                    dummy_labels,
                    anchor_proj,
                    pos_proj,
                    neg_proj,

                loss = total

            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()

            scheduler.step()
            total_cont_loss += loss.item()

    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
        labels = batch[2].to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        with autocast():
            logits = model(input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False)
            loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)(logits, labels)

        if scaler is not None:
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        else:
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        total_cls_loss += loss.item()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    all_val_probs = []
    all_val_labels = []

            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)

    val_labels = np.concatenate(all_val_labels)
    val_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)

    avg_train_loss = total_loss / max(len(train_loader), 1)

print(f"\nBest model: epoch {best_epoch}, val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}")

# Load best model

with torch.no_grad():

This causes index out of bounds errors.

The fix is to ensure that when subsampling contrastive data, we sample from indices valid for all three arrays simultaneously.

def create_contrastive_pairs(texts, labels, max_pairs_per_sample=3):
    n = len(texts)
    author_groups = {}
    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
        if label not in author_groups:
            author_groups[label] = []
        author_groups[label].append(i)

    anchors = []
    positives = []
    negatives = []

    for i in range(n):
        anchor_label = labels[i]
        same_author_indices = author_groups[anchor_label]
        positive_candidates = [idx for idx in same_author_indices if idx != i]
        if positive_candidates:
            num_pos = min(max_pairs_per_sample, len(positive_candidates))
            selected_pos = np.random.choice(
                positive_candidates, size=num_pos, replace=False
            )
            for pos_idx in selected_pos:
                anchors.append(texts[i])
                positives.append(texts[pos_idx])

        other_author_indices = []
        for label, indices in author_groups.items():
            if label != anchor_label:
                other_author_indices.extend(indices)
        if other_author_indices:
            num_neg = min(max_pairs_per_sample, len(other_author_indices))
            selected_neg = np.random.choice(
                other_author_indices, size=num_neg, replace=False
            )
            for neg_idx in selected_neg:
                anchors.append(texts[i])
                negatives.append(texts[neg_idx])

    return np.array(anchors), np.array(positives), np.array(negatives)

        words = text.split()

        noun_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in noun_suffixes)
        )
        verb_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in verb_suffixes)
        )
        adj_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in adj_suffixes)
        )
        adv_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in adv_suffixes)
        )
        conj_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in conjunctions)
        prep_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in prepositions)
        pron_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in pronouns)
        function_words = (
            conjunctions
            | prepositions
            | pronouns
            | {
                "the",
                "a",

                "are",
                "was",

            }
        )
        content_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() not in function_words)
        content_ratio = content_count / word_count
        features_list.append(
            np.array(

                    noun_count / word_count,
                    verb_count / word_count,
                    adj_count / word_count,
                    adv_count / word_count,
                    conj_count / word_count,
                    prep_count / word_count,
                    pron_count / word_count,
                    content_ratio,
                ]
            )
        )
    return np.vstack(features_list)

class ContrastiveAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name=MODEL_NAME, num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.output_hidden_states = True

        self.encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.encoder.gradient_checkpointing_enable()

        self.projection_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, PROJECTION_DIM),
        )

        self.classification_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, num_labels),
        )

        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.projection_head, self.classification_head]:
            for layer in module:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                elif isinstance(layer, nn.LayerNorm):
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classification_head(pooled_output)

        if return_embeddings:
            projections = self.projection_head(pooled_output)
            projections = F.normalize(projections, p=2, dim=1)
            return logits, projections
        return logits

    def encode_sentence(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.encoder(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                return_dict=True,
            )
            pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        return pooled_output


class NTXentLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.cross_entropy = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction="mean")

    def forward(self, anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings):
        batch_size = anchor_embeddings.size(0)
        anchor = F.normalize(anchor_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        positive = F.normalize(positive_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        negative = F.normalize(negative_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)

        pos_sim = torch.sum(anchor * positive, dim=1) / self.temperature
        neg_sim = torch.sum(anchor * negative, dim=1) / self.temperature

        logits = torch.stack([pos_sim, neg_sim], dim=1)
        labels = torch.zeros(batch_size, dtype=torch.long, device=anchor.device)
        loss = self.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
        return loss


class CombinedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, contrastive_weight=0.5, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.contrastive_weight = contrastive_weight
        self.contrastive_loss = NTXentLoss(temperature=temperature)
        self.classification_loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    def forward(
        self,
        logits,
        labels,
        anchor_embeddings,
        positive_embeddings,
        negative_embeddings,
    ):
        cls_loss = self.classification_loss(logits, labels)
        cont_loss = self.contrastive_loss(
            anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings
        )
        total_loss = cls_loss + self.contrastive_weight * cont_loss
        return total_loss, cls_loss, cont_loss

class ContrastiveDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, anchor_texts, pos_texts, neg_texts, tokenizer, max_length=512):
        self.anchor_texts = anchor_texts
        self.pos_texts = pos_texts
        self.neg_texts = neg_texts
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.anchor_texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.anchor_texts[idx], self.pos_texts[idx], self.neg_texts[idx]


def collate_contrastive(batch):
    anchors = [item[0] for item in batch]
    positives = [item[1] for item in batch]
    negatives = [item[2] for item in batch]
    anchor_enc = tokenizer(
        anchors,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    pos_enc = tokenizer(
        positives,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    neg_enc = tokenizer(
        negatives,
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    return (
        anchor_enc["input_ids"],
        anchor_enc["attention_mask"],
        pos_enc["input_ids"],
        pos_enc["attention_mask"],
        neg_enc["input_ids"],
        neg_enc["attention_mask"],
    )

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

    # Contrastive phase
    if epoch < contrastive_epochs or epoch % 2 == 0:
        for batch_idx, batch in enumerate(contrastive_loader):
            anc_ids, anc_mask, pos_ids, pos_mask, neg_ids, neg_mask = [

            optimizer.zero_grad()

                logits_anc, anchor_proj = model(

                )
                logits_pos, pos_proj = model(pos_ids, pos_mask, return_embeddings=True)
                logits_neg, neg_proj = model(neg_ids, neg_mask, return_embeddings=True)

                dummy_labels = torch.zeros(
                    anc_ids.size(0), dtype=torch.long, device=device
                )
                total, cls_l, cont_l = criterion(
                    torch.zeros(anc_ids.size(0), NUM_AUTHORS, device=device),
                    dummy_labels,
                    anchor_proj,
                    pos_proj,
                    neg_proj,
                )
                loss = cont_l * CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT

            if scaler is not None:
                scaler.scale(loss).backward()

                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                scaler.step(optimizer)
                scaler.update()
            else:
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
                optimizer.step()

            total_cont_loss += loss.item()

            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        else:
            loss.backward()

            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        total_cls_loss += loss.item()

        features[i, 0] = np.mean(word_lengths)
        features[i, 1] = np.std(word_lengths) if len(word_lengths) > 1 else 0
        features[i, 2] = np.max(word_lengths)
        short_words = sum(1 for w in word_lengths if w <= 3)
        features[i, 3] = short_words / max(len(words), 1) * 100
        latin_words = 0
        for w in words:
            w_lower = w.lower()
            for suffix in latin_suffixes:
                if w_lower.endswith(suffix):
                    latin_words += 1
                    break
        features[i, 4] = latin_words / max(len(words), 1) * 100
        double_letter = sum(1 for w in words if re.search(r"(.)\1", w.lower()))
        features[i, 5] = double_letter / max(len(words), 1) * 100
        gh_words = sum(1 for w in words if "gh" in w.lower())
        features[i, 6] = gh_words / max(len(words), 1) * 100
        ck_words = sum(1 for w in words if "ck" in w.lower())
        features[i, 7] = ck_words / max(len(words), 1) * 100
    return features


def get_basic_stats(texts):
    features = np.zeros((len(texts), 6))
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            continue
        len_text = len(text)
        num_sentences = max(len(re.findall(r"[.!?]+", text)), 1)
        num_words = len(text.split())
        features[i, 0] = len_text
        features[i, 1] = num_words
        features[i, 2] = len_text / num_sentences
        features[i, 3] = num_words / num_sentences
        features[i, 4] = len_text / max(num_words, 1)
        features[i, 5] = 1.0 if num_words <= 3 else 0.0
    return features


# ============================================================
# Extract all features
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("EXTRACTING FEATURES")

test_syllable = extract_syllable_features(test_texts)

print("Extracting punctuation rhythm features...")

val_punct_rhythm = extract_punctuation_rhythm(val_texts)
test_punct_rhythm = extract_punctuation_rhythm(test_texts)

print("Extracting orthographic features...")
train_ortho = extract_orthographic_features(train_texts)
val_ortho = extract_orthographic_features(val_texts)
test_ortho = extract_orthographic_features(test_texts)

print("Extracting structure features...")
train_structure = extract_structure_features(train_texts)
val_structure = extract_structure_features(val_texts)
test_structure = extract_structure_features(test_texts)

print("Extracting character pattern features...")
train_char_pattern = extract_char_pattern_features(train_texts)
val_char_pattern = extract_char_pattern_features(val_texts)
test_char_pattern = extract_char_pattern_features(test_texts)

print("Extracting vocabulary complexity features...")
train_vocab = extract_vocabulary_complexity(train_texts)
val_vocab = extract_vocabulary_complexity(val_texts)
test_vocab = extract_vocabulary_complexity(test_texts)

print("\nCombining all features...")
all_train_features = np.hstack(
    [
        train_syllable,
        train_punct_rhythm,

        train_structure,

)
print(f"Total features: {all_train_features.shape[1]}")

print("\nRemoving constant features...")
non_constant_cols = np.where(np.std(all_train_features, axis=0) > 1e-8)[0]
print(
    f"Non-constant features: {len(non_constant_cols)} out of {all_train_features.shape[1]}"
)
all_train_features = all_train_features[:, non_constant_cols]
all_val_features = all_val_features[:, non_constant_cols]
all_test_features = all_test_features[:, non_constant_cols]

print("\nStandardizing features...")
scaler = StandardScaler()
train_features_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(all_train_features)
val_features_scaled = scaler.transform(all_val_features)
test_features_scaled = scaler.transform(all_test_features)

print("Computing basic text statistics...")

val_basic = get_basic_stats(val_texts)
test_basic = get_basic_stats(test_texts)

basic_scaler = StandardScaler()

test_basic_scaled = basic_scaler.transform(test_basic)

train_features_final = np.hstack([train_features_scaled, train_basic_scaled])
val_features_final = np.hstack([val_features_scaled, val_basic_scaled])

print(
    f"\nFinal feature dimensions: Train: {train_features_final.shape}, Val: {val_features_final.shape}, Test: {test_features_final.shape}"
)

# ============================================================
# MODEL ARCHITECTURE: MultiResolutionAuthorClassifier
# ============================================================


class MultiResolutionAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        model_name=MODEL_NAME,
        num_classes=NUM_AUTHORS,
        hidden_size=768,
        dropout_rate=DROPOUT,
        stylo_dim=30,
        readability_dim=8,
        pos_dim=6,
        ngram_dim=None,
        use_contrastive=False,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_classes = num_classes
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.use_contrastive = use_contrastive

        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout_rate
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout_rate
        self.config.output_hidden_states = True

        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        for name, param in self.transformer.named_parameters():
            if "encoder.layer" in name:
                layer_num = int(name.split("encoder.layer.")[1].split(".")[0])
                if layer_num < self.config.num_hidden_layers - 4:
                    param.requires_grad = False

        transformer_hidden = self.config.hidden_size
        self.transformer_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(transformer_hidden, hidden_size),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.stylo_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(stylo_dim, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.readability_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(readability_dim, hidden_size // 4),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.pos_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(pos_dim, hidden_size // 4),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )

        if ngram_dim is not None:
            self.ngram_encoder = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(ngram_dim, hidden_size // 2),
                nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            )
        else:
            self.ngram_encoder = None

        self.fusion_dim = hidden_size
        self.num_fusion_heads = 4
        self.fusion_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=self.fusion_dim,
            num_heads=self.num_fusion_heads,
            dropout=dropout_rate,
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.modality_embeddings = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, 5, self.fusion_dim) * 0.02
        )

        self.fusion_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.fusion_dim * 5, self.fusion_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.fusion_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(self.fusion_dim, self.fusion_dim // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.fusion_dim // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.fusion_dim // 2, self.fusion_dim // 4),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.fusion_dim // 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout_rate),
            nn.Linear(self.fusion_dim // 4, num_classes),
        )

        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in self.modules():
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                nn.init.kaiming_normal_(
                    module.weight, mode="fan_out", nonlinearity="relu"
                )
                if module.bias is not None:
                    nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
            elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
                nn.init.constant_(module.bias, 0)
                nn.init.constant_(module.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        stylo_features,
        readability_features,
        pos_features,
        ngram_features=None,
        return_embeddings=False,
    ):
        batch_size = input_ids.size(0)

        transformer_outputs = self.transformer(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = transformer_outputs.hidden_states[-1]
        cls_embedding = hidden_states[:, 0, :]
        transformer_features = self.transformer_proj(cls_embedding)

        stylo_features_proj = self.stylo_encoder(stylo_features)
        readability_features_proj = self.readability_encoder(readability_features)
        pos_features_proj = self.pos_encoder(pos_features)

        if ngram_features is not None and self.ngram_encoder is not None:
            ngram_features_proj = self.ngram_encoder(ngram_features)
        else:
            ngram_features_proj = torch.zeros(
                batch_size, self.fusion_dim // 2, device=transformer_features.device
            )

        device = transformer_features.device
        proj_to_fusion = nn.Linear(transformer_features.size(-1), self.fusion_dim).to(
            device
        )

        features_sequence = torch.stack(
            [
                proj_to_fusion(transformer_features),
                proj_to_fusion(
                    F.pad(
                        stylo_features_proj,
                        (0, self.fusion_dim - stylo_features_proj.size(-1)),
                    )
                ),
                proj_to_fusion(
                    F.pad(
                        readability_features_proj,
                        (0, self.fusion_dim - readability_features_proj.size(-1)),
                    )
                ),
                proj_to_fusion(
                    F.pad(
                        pos_features_proj,
                        (0, self.fusion_dim - pos_features_proj.size(-1)),
                    )
                ),
                proj_to_fusion(
                    F.pad(
                        ngram_features_proj,
                        (0, self.fusion_dim - ngram_features_proj.size(-1)),
                    )
                ),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        features_sequence = features_sequence + self.modality_embeddings
        attended_features, attention_weights = self.fusion_attention(
            features_sequence, features_sequence, features_sequence
        )
        fused_features = attended_features.reshape(batch_size, -1)

        combined_features = self.fusion_proj(fused_features)
        logits = self.classifier(combined_features)

        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, attention_weights
        return logits


# ============================================================
# Compute feature split dimensions
# ============================================================
stylo_dim = 30
readability_dim = 8
pos_dim = 6
ngram_dim = train_features_final.shape[1] - (stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim)

# ============================================================
# Initialize tokenizer and model
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("INITIALIZING MODEL")
print("=" * 60)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = MultiResolutionAuthorClassifier(
    stylo_dim=stylo_dim,
    readability_dim=readability_dim,
    pos_dim=pos_dim,
    ngram_dim=max(ngram_dim, 1),
    use_contrastive=False,
)
model.to(device)

# ============================================================
# Tokenize texts
# ============================================================
print("Tokenizing texts...")
train_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(train_texts),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)
val_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(val_texts),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)
test_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(test_texts),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)

train_features_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(train_features_final)
val_features_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(val_features_final)
test_features_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(test_features_final)
train_labels_tensor = torch.LongTensor(train_labels)
val_labels_tensor = torch.LongTensor(val_labels)

# ============================================================
# Prepare data loaders
# ============================================================
train_dataset = TensorDataset(
    train_encodings["input_ids"],
    train_encodings["attention_mask"],
    train_features_tensor,
    train_labels_tensor,
)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(
    val_encodings["input_ids"],
    val_encodings["attention_mask"],
    val_features_tensor,
    val_labels_tensor,
)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(
    test_encodings["input_ids"], test_encodings["attention_mask"], test_features_tensor
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,
    shuffle=False,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
)

# ============================================================
# Optimizer and scheduler
# ============================================================
no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
transformer_params = []
other_params = []
for name, param in model.named_parameters():
    if param.requires_grad:
        if "transformer" in name:
            transformer_params.append(param)
        else:
            other_params.append(param)

optimizer = AdamW(
    [
        {
            "params": transformer_params,
            "lr": LEARNING_RATE * 0.5,
            "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
        },
        {"params": other_params, "lr": LEARNING_RATE, "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY},
    ],
    eps=1e-8,
)

total_steps = len(train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=WARMUP_STEPS, num_training_steps=total_steps
)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None


# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n


def evaluate(model, loader, criterion, device):
    model.eval()
    all_losses = []
    all_probs = []
    all_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            features = batch[2].to(device)
            labels = batch[3].to(device)

            stylo_feats = features[:, :stylo_dim]
            readability_feats = features[:, stylo_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim]
            pos_feats = features[
                :, stylo_dim + readability_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim
            ]
            ngram_feats = features[:, stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim :]

            with autocast(enabled=(scaler is not None)):
                logits = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    stylo_features=stylo_feats,
                    readability_features=readability_feats,
                    pos_features=pos_feats,
                    ngram_features=ngram_feats,
                    return_embeddings=False,
                )
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)

            all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
            all_losses.append(loss.item())

    all_probs = np.vstack(all_probs)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    avg_loss = np.mean(all_losses)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_probs)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_probs, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return avg_loss, logloss, acc, all_probs


# ============================================================
# TRAINING LOOP
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("TRAINING MultiResolutionAuthorClassifier")
print("=" * 60)

best_val_logloss = float("inf")
best_epoch = 0
patience_counter = 0

for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    total_train_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0

    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
        features = batch[2].to(device)
        labels = batch[3].to(device)

        stylo_feats = features[:, :stylo_dim]
        readability_feats = features[:, stylo_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim]
        pos_feats = features[
            :, stylo_dim + readability_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim
        ]
        ngram_feats = features[:, stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim :]

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        if scaler is not None:
            with autocast():
                logits = model(
                    input_ids=input_ids,
                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
                    stylo_features=stylo_feats,
                    readability_features=readability_feats,
                    pos_features=pos_feats,
                    ngram_features=ngram_feats,
                    return_embeddings=False,
                )
                loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        else:
            logits = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                stylo_features=stylo_feats,
                readability_features=readability_feats,
                pos_features=pos_feats,
                ngram_features=ngram_feats,
                return_embeddings=False,
            )
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()
        total_train_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1

    avg_train_loss = total_train_loss / max(num_batches, 1)
    val_loss, val_logloss, val_acc, _ = evaluate(model, val_loader, criterion, device)

    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val LogLoss: {val_logloss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}"
    )

    if val_logloss < best_val_logloss:
        best_val_logloss = val_logloss
        best_epoch = epoch + 1
        patience_counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "best_model.pt"))
        print(f"  --> New best model saved (logloss: {val_logloss:.4f})")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}, Best logloss: {best_val_logloss:.4f}"
            )
            break

print(
    f"\nLoading best model from epoch {best_epoch} with validation logloss {best_val_logloss:.4f}"
)
model.load_state_dict(
    torch.load(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "best_model.pt"), map_location=device)
)

# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION SCORE
# ============================================================
_, final_val_logloss, final_val_acc, _ = evaluate(model, val_loader, criterion, device)
print(
    f"Final validation logloss: {final_val_logloss:.6f}, accuracy: {final_val_acc:.4f}"
)

# ============================================================
# TEST INFERENCE
# ============================================================
print("\nPerforming test inference...")
model.eval()
all_test_probs = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
        features = batch[2].to(device)

        stylo_feats = features[:, :stylo_dim]
        readability_feats = features[:, stylo_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim]
        pos_feats = features[
            :, stylo_dim + readability_dim : stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim
        ]
        ngram_feats = features[:, stylo_dim + readability_dim + pos_dim :]

        with autocast(enabled=(scaler is not None)):
            logits = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                stylo_features=stylo_feats,
                readability_features=readability_feats,
                pos_features=pos_feats,
                ngram_features=ngram_feats,
                return_embeddings=False,
            )
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)

        all_test_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())

test_probs = np.vstack(all_test_probs)

eps = 1e-15
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)
row_sums = test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_probs = test_probs / row_sums
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, eps, 1 - eps)

# ============================================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION
# ============================================================
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(submission_df.head())

print(f"\nFinal Validation Score: {final_val_logloss:.6f}")

gc.collect()
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

## Evaluation

Submissions are evaluated using multi-class logarithmic loss. Each id has one true class. For each id, you must submit a predicted probability for each author. The formula is then:

$$\text{log loss} = -\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^M y_{ij} \log(p_{ij})$$

where N is the number of observations in the test set, M is the number of class labels (3 classes), \\(log\\) is the natural logarithm, \\(y_{ij}\\) is 1 if observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\) and 0 otherwise, and \\(p_{ij}\\) is the predicted probability that observation \\(i\\) belongs to class \\(j\\).

The submitted probabilities for a given sentences are not required to sum to one because they are rescaled prior to being scored (each row is divided by the row sum). In order to avoid the extremes of the log function, predicted probabilities are replaced with \\(max(min(p,1-10^{-15}),10^{-15})\\).

## 🚨 DATA LEAKAGE PREVENTION

- 
- ⚠️ **Strict Isolation Principle**: Validation/Test data must remain strictly unseen during training.
- 
- ✅ **Sequence**: Always **Split Data FIRST**, then apply processing.
- ✅ **Stateful Transformations**: Fit all Scalers, Encoders, Imputers, and Tokenizers **ONLY on Training data**, then use `.transform()` on Validation/Test.
- ✅ **Feature Engineering**: Calculate global statistics (e.g., mean, variance, vocabulary) solely from the Training set.
- ✅ **Target Leakage**: Never use target information (e.g., Target Encoding) from the validation set.

- 🔴🔴🔴 **CRITICAL: INDEX_BUG — The #1 Cause of Validation Leakage** 🔴🔴🔴
- 
- **THIS BUG HAS CAUSED 3+ RUNS TO PRODUCE COMPLETELY INVALID RESULTS (log_loss 0.008~0.05 that are FAKE).**
- 
- **The Bug**: After `reset_index(drop=True)`, using `.index.tolist()` to index into the ORIGINAL DataFrame causes label-text misalignment:
- 
- ```python
- # ❌❌❌ WRONG — THIS IS THE INDEX_BUG THAT CAUSES VALIDATION LEAKAGE:
- train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)  # index becomes 0,1,2,...
- val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)    # index becomes 0,1,2,...
- train_indices = train_set.index.tolist()  # [0,1,2,...] — WRONG! These are NOT the original positions!
- val_indices = val_set.index.tolist()      # [0,1,2,...] — WRONG!
- train_labels_final = train_labels_orig[train_indices]  # Labels from WRONG rows!
- val_labels_final = train_labels_orig[val_indices]      # Labels from WRONG rows!
- ```
- 
- When `reset_index(drop=True)` resets the index to 0,1,2,..., using those indices on the original
- DataFrame's `.values` array selects the FIRST N rows — NOT the split rows. This causes text-label
- misalignment, which often manifests as unrealistically low validation loss (0.008-0.05 in author ID tasks).
- 
- ```python
- # ✅✅✅ CORRECT — Option A: Use split indices directly (numpy indexing):
- train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df['author']))
- train_texts = train_df['text'].values[train_idx]
- train_labels = train_labels_orig[train_idx]  # train_idx are the CORRECT positions
- val_texts = train_df['text'].values[val_idx]
- val_labels = train_labels_orig[val_idx]
- 
- # ✅✅✅ CORRECT — Option B: Get data directly from sub-DataFrames:
- train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
- val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

- val_labels = val_set['author_encoded'].values

- train_set = train_df.iloc[train_idx]  # Keep original index
- val_set = train_df.iloc[val_idx]
- train_texts = train_set['text'].values
- train_labels = train_set['author_encoded'].values
- ```

- ✅ **SAFE APPROACHES:**
- 
- **Option A (Recommended): Don't change model class. Use standard AutoModelForSequenceClassification and extract embeddings via outputs.hidden_states.**

- 
- **Option B: If you must modify architecture, use filtered loading:**
- ```python
- state_dict = torch.load(path, map_location=device)
- model_state = model.state_dict()
- filtered = {k: v for k, v in state_dict.items() if k in model_state and v.shape == model_state[k].shape}
- model.load_state_dict(filtered, strict=False)
- print(f'Loaded {len(filtered)}/{len(model_state)} parameters from checkpoint')

Feature engineering extracts 63 hand-crafted stylistic features (syllable patterns, punctuation rhythm, orthographic patterns, structural markers, character patterns, vocabulary complexity) which are standardized and combined with basic text statistics. The model architecture (MultiResolutionAuthorClassifier) fuses a DeBERTa-v3-large transformer encoder with separate encoders for stylistic, readability, POS, and n-gram features via multi-head attention fusion, followed by a classifier head. """
Merged Script: Data Processing + ContrastiveAuthorClassifier + Training/Evaluation
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import warnings

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler

from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,
    AutoModel,
    AutoConfig,
    get_linear_schedule_with_warmup,
)
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import string

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
RANDOM_STATE = 42
NUM_AUTHORS = 3
MODEL_NAME = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
MAX_LENGTH = 512
BATCH_SIZE = 8
LEARNING_RATE = 1.5e-5
WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.01
NUM_EPOCHS = 15
WARMUP_RATIO = 0.1
PATIENCE = 4
DROPOUT_RATE = 0.2
PROJECTION_DIM = 256
CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE = 0.1
CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT = 0.15
GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS = 2

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
torch.manual_seed(RANDOM_STATE)
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(RANDOM_STATE)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================
TRAIN_CSV = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_CSV = "./input/test.csv"
OUTPUT_CSV = "./submission/submission.csv"
WORKING_DIR = "./working"
os.makedirs(WORKING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# ============================================================
print("=" * 60)
print("LOADING DATA")
print("=" * 60)

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_CSV)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_CSV)
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
train_df["author_encoded"] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["author"])
print(
    f"Label encoding: {dict(zip(label_encoder.classes_, range(len(label_encoder.classes_))))}"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. STRATIFIED SPLIT
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("STRATIFIED SPLIT")
print("=" * 60)

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE)
train_idx, val_idx = next(skf.split(train_df, train_df["author"]))

X_train_texts = train_df["text"].values[train_idx]
y_train_labels = train_df["author_encoded"].values[train_idx]
X_val_texts = train_df["text"].values[val_idx]
y_val_labels = train_df["author_encoded"].values[val_idx]

max_contrastive_samples = 30000
# Ensure we use the minimum length across all arrays for subsampling
min_len = min(len(anchor_texts), len(pos_texts), len(neg_texts))
if min_len > max_contrastive_samples:
    idx = np.random.choice(min_len, max_contrastive_samples, replace=False)
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[:min_len][idx]
    pos_texts_sub = pos_texts[:min_len][idx]
    neg_texts_sub = neg_texts[:min_len][idx]
else:
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[:min_len]
    pos_texts_sub = pos_texts[:min_len]
    neg_texts_sub = neg_texts[:min_len]

max_contrastive_samples = 30000
# Ensure we use the minimum length across all arrays for subsampling
min_len = min(len(anchor_texts), len(pos_texts), len(neg_texts))
if min_len > max_contrastive_samples:
    idx = np.random.choice(min_len, max_contrastive_samples, replace=False)
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[idx]
    pos_texts_sub = pos_texts[idx]
    neg_texts_sub = neg_texts[idx]
else:
    anchor_texts_sub = anchor_texts[:min_len]

print(

)
print(f"Train author distribution: {np.bincount(y_train_labels)}")
print(f"Val author distribution: {np.bincount(y_val_labels)}")

# ============================================================
# 3. CONTRASTIVE PAIR CREATION
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("CREATING CONTRASTIVE TRAINING PAIRS")
print("=" * 60)

def create_contrastive_pairs(texts, labels, max_pairs_per_sample=3):
    n = len(texts)
    author_groups = {}
    for i, label in enumerate(labels):
        if label not in author_groups:
            author_groups[label] = []
        author_groups[label].append(i)

    anchors = []
    positives = []
    negatives = []

    for i in range(n):
        anchor_label = labels[i]
        same_author_indices = author_groups[anchor_label]
        positive_candidates = [idx for idx in same_author_indices if idx != i]
        if positive_candidates:
            num_pos = min(max_pairs_per_sample, len(positive_candidates))
            selected_pos = np.random.choice(
                positive_candidates, size=num_pos, replace=False
            )
            for pos_idx in selected_pos:
                anchors.append(texts[i])
                positives.append(texts[pos_idx])

        other_author_indices = []
        for label, indices in author_groups.items():
            if label != anchor_label:
                other_author_indices.extend(indices)
        if other_author_indices:
            num_neg = min(max_pairs_per_sample, len(other_author_indices))
            selected_neg = np.random.choice(
                other_author_indices, size=num_neg, replace=False
            )
            for neg_idx in selected_neg:
                anchors.append(texts[i])
                negatives.append(texts[neg_idx])

    return np.array(anchors), np.array(positives), np.array(negatives)

anchor_texts, pos_texts, neg_texts = create_contrastive_pairs(
    X_train_texts, y_train_labels, max_pairs_per_sample=2
)

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) == 0:
            features_list.append(np.zeros(42))
            continue

        text_lower = text.lower()
        words = text.split()
        chars = list(text)

        char_count = len(text)
        word_count = len(words)
        sent_count = len(re.findall(r"[.!?]+", text)) + (
            1 if text.rstrip()[-1:] in ".!?" else 0
        )
        avg_word_len = char_count / max(word_count, 1)
        avg_sent_len = word_count / max(sent_count, 1)

        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.isupper()) / max(char_count, 1)
        lower_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.islower()) / max(char_count, 1)
        digit_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.isdigit()) / max(char_count, 1)
        whitespace_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.isspace()) / max(char_count, 1)
        alpha_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.isalpha()) / max(char_count, 1)
        vowel_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c.lower() in "aeiou") / max(char_count, 1)
        consonant_ratio = sum(
            1 for c in chars if c.isalpha() and c.lower() not in "aeiou"
        ) / max(char_count, 1)
        punct_ratio = sum(1 for c in chars if c in string.punctuation) / max(
            char_count, 1
        )
        unique_char_ratio = len(set(chars)) / max(char_count, 1)

        punct_counts = {
            "comma": text.count(","),
            "period": text.count("."),
            "excl": text.count("!"),
            "quest": text.count("?"),
            "semicolon": text.count(";"),
            "colon": text.count(":"),
            "dash": text.count("-") + text.count("—") + text.count("–"),
            "quote": text.count('"')
            + text.count("'")
            + text.count('"')
            + text.count('"'),
            "paren": text.count("(")
            + text.count(")")
            + text.count("[")
            + text.count("]"),
            "hyphen": text.count("-"),
            "ellipsis": text.count("...") + text.count(".."),
            "apostrophe": text.count("'"),
            "slash": text.count("/") + text.count("\\"),
        }
        punct_ratios = {k: v / max(char_count, 1) for k, v in punct_counts.items()}

        unique_words = len(set(words))
        lexical_diversity = unique_words / max(word_count, 1)
        ttr = unique_words / max(np.log(word_count + 1), 0.1) if word_count > 0 else 0
        if word_count > 0:
            word_freq = {}
            for w in words:
                word_freq[w] = word_freq.get(w, 0) + 1
            hapax_count = sum(1 for v in word_freq.values() if v == 1)
            hapax_ratio = hapax_count / unique_words if unique_words > 0 else 0
        else:
            hapax_ratio = 0

        long_words_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 8) / max(word_count, 1)
        very_long_words_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 12) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )
        all_caps_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )
        capitalized_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper() if w) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        archaic_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in archaic_words) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )
        lovecraft_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in lovecraft_words) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )
        poe_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in poe_words) / max(word_count, 1)
        shelley_ratio = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in shelley_words) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        if sent_count > 1:
            sent_lengths = [
                len(s.split()) for s in re.split(r"[.!?]+", text) if s.strip()
            ]
            sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 1 else 0
        else:
            sent_len_std = 0

        stopwords_ratio = sum(
            1
            for w in words
            if w.lower()
            in {
                "the",

                "most",
                "other",
                "some",
                "such",
                "only",
                "own",
                "same",
                "very",
                "too",
            }
        ) / max(word_count, 1)

        feature_vector = np.array(
            [
                char_count,
                word_count,
                sent_count,
                avg_word_len,
                avg_sent_len,
                upper_ratio,
                lower_ratio,
                digit_ratio,
                whitespace_ratio,
                alpha_ratio,
                vowel_ratio,
                consonant_ratio,
                punct_ratio,
                unique_char_ratio,
                punct_ratios["comma"],
                punct_ratios["period"],
                punct_ratios["excl"],
                punct_ratios["quest"],

                punct_ratios["colon"],

                punct_ratios["quote"],

                punct_ratios["hyphen"],
                punct_ratios["ellipsis"],
                punct_ratios["apostrophe"],
                punct_ratios["slash"],
                lexical_diversity,
                ttr,
                hapax_ratio,
                long_words_ratio,
                very_long_words_ratio,
                all_caps_ratio,
                capitalized_ratio,
                archaic_ratio,
                lovecraft_ratio,
                poe_ratio,
                shelley_ratio,
                sent_len_std,
                stopwords_ratio,
            ]
        )
        features_list.append(feature_vector)
    return np.vstack(features_list)

def create_readability_features(texts):
    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
        if not word:
            return 0
        vowels = "aeiouy"
        count = 0
        prev_is_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            is_vowel = char in vowels
            if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                count += 1
            prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
        if word.endswith("e") and count > 1:
            count -= 1
        return max(count, 1)

    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            features_list.append(np.zeros(5))
            continue
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        word_count = len(words)
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)
        char_count = len(text)
        total_syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / max(word_count, 1)
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) >= 3)
        complex_word_ratio = complex_words / max(word_count, 1)
        if word_count > 0 and sent_count > 0:
            flesch = (
                206.835
                - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 84.6 * (total_syllables / word_count)
            )
            ari = (
                4.71 * (char_count / word_count)
                + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
                - 21.43
            )
            L = (char_count / word_count) * 100
            S = (sent_count / word_count) * 100
            coleman_liau = 0.0588 * L - 0.296 * S - 15.8
        else:
            flesch, ari, coleman_liau = 0, 0, 0
        features_list.append(
            np.array([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_word_ratio, coleman_liau])
        )
    return np.vstack(features_list)

def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",

        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",

        "ible",
        "ful",
        "less",
        "al",
        "ic",
        "ical",
        "esque",
    ]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "wards", "wise"]
    conjunctions = set(
        [
            "and",

            "or",
            "nor",
            "yet",
            "so",
            "for",
            "although",
            "because",

        ]

    prepositions = set(

            "by",
            "from",
            "of",
            "about",
            "around",

            "through",
            "under",
            "over",
            "before",
            "after",
            "during",
            "without",
            "against",
            "within",
            "across",
            "behind",
            "along",
            "toward",
            "upon",
        ]
    )
    pronouns = set(
        [
            "i",
            "you",
            "he",
            "she",
            "it",
            "we",
            "they",
            "me",
            "him",
            "her",
            "us",
            "them",
            "my",
            "your",
            "his",
            "its",
            "our",
            "their",
            "mine",
            "yours",
            "hers",
            "ours",
            "theirs",
            "myself",
            "yourself",
            "himself",
            "herself",

            "themselves",
            "this",
            "that",
            "these",
            "those",
            "who",
            "whom",
            "which",
            "what",
        ]
    )

    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            features_list.append(np.zeros(8))
            continue
        words = text.split()
        word_count = max(len(words), 1)
        noun_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in noun_suffixes)
        )
        verb_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in verb_suffixes)
        )
        adj_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in adj_suffixes)
        )
        adv_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(suf) for suf in adv_suffixes)
        )
        conj_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in conjunctions)
        prep_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in prepositions)
        pron_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in pronouns)
        function_words = (
            conjunctions
            | prepositions
            | pronouns
            | {
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "is",
                "are",
                "was",
                "were",
                "be",
                "been",

                "not",
                "no",
            }
        )
        content_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() not in function_words)
        content_ratio = content_count / word_count
        features_list.append(
            np.array(
                [
                    noun_count / word_count,
                    verb_count / word_count,
                    adj_count / word_count,
                    adv_count / word_count,
                    conj_count / word_count,
                    prep_count / word_count,
                    pron_count / word_count,
                    content_ratio,
                ]
            )
        )
    return np.vstack(features_list)

class ContrastiveAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name=MODEL_NAME, num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = DROPOUT_RATE
        self.config.output_hidden_states = True

        self.encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name, config=self.config)
        self.hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        # Disable gradient checkpointing to avoid graph reuse issues with contrastive training
        # self.encoder.gradient_checkpointing_enable()

        self.projection_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, PROJECTION_DIM),
        )

        self.classification_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size, self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(self.hidden_size // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),
            nn.Linear(self.hidden_size // 2, num_labels),
        )

        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        for module in [self.projection_head, self.classification_head]:
            for layer in module:
                if isinstance(layer, nn.Linear):
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(layer.weight)
                    if layer.bias is not None:
                        nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                elif isinstance(layer, nn.LayerNorm):
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.bias, 0)
                    nn.init.constant_(layer.weight, 1.0)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        logits = self.classification_head(pooled_output)

        if return_embeddings:
            projections = self.projection_head(pooled_output)
            projections = F.normalize(projections, p=2, dim=1)
            return logits, projections
        return logits

    def encode_sentence(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = self.encoder(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                return_dict=True,
            )
            pooled_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        return pooled_output

class NTXentLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.temperature = temperature
        self.cross_entropy = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction="mean")

    def forward(self, anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings):
        batch_size = anchor_embeddings.size(0)
        anchor = F.normalize(anchor_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        positive = F.normalize(positive_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)
        negative = F.normalize(negative_embeddings, p=2, dim=1)

        pos_sim = torch.sum(anchor * positive, dim=1) / self.temperature
        neg_sim = torch.sum(anchor * negative, dim=1) / self.temperature

        logits = torch.stack([pos_sim, neg_sim], dim=1)
        labels = torch.zeros(batch_size, dtype=torch.long, device=anchor.device)
        loss = self.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
        return loss

class CombinedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, contrastive_weight=0.5, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE):
        super().__init__()
        self.contrastive_weight = contrastive_weight
        self.contrastive_loss = NTXentLoss(temperature=temperature)
        self.classification_loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    def forward(
        self,
        logits,
        labels,
        anchor_embeddings,
        positive_embeddings,
        negative_embeddings,
    ):
        cls_loss = self.classification_loss(logits, labels)
        cont_loss = self.contrastive_loss(
            anchor_embeddings, positive_embeddings, negative_embeddings
        )
        total_loss = cls_loss + self.contrastive_weight * cont_loss
        return total_loss, cls_loss, cont_loss

print(f"Model: ContrastiveAuthorClassifier with {MODEL_NAME}")
model = ContrastiveAuthorClassifier(model_name=MODEL_NAME, num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS)
model.to(device)
print(f"Total parameters: {sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()):,}")

criterion = CombinedLoss(
    contrastive_weight=CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT, temperature=CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE
)
print(
    f"Criterion: CombinedLoss(contrastive_weight={CONTRASTIVE_WEIGHT}, temperature={CONTRASTIVE_TEMPERATURE})"
)

# ============================================================
# 11. DATALOADERS
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("CREATING DATALOADERS")
print("=" * 60)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)

def tokenize_texts(texts):
    return tokenizer(
        list(texts),
        truncation=True,
        padding=True,
        max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

train_enc = tokenize_texts(X_train_texts)
val_enc = tokenize_texts(X_val_texts)
test_enc = tokenize_texts(test_df["text"].values)

train_dataset = TensorDataset(
    train_enc["input_ids"],
    train_enc["attention_mask"],
    torch.tensor(y_train_labels, dtype=torch.long),
)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(

    torch.tensor(y_val_labels, dtype=torch.long),
)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(test_enc["input_ids"], test_enc["attention_mask"])

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=2,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
